about: Premade assets AMAL may fetch for a job (premade.rs). Only CC0 and CC-BY (credited). Sources are asked live through their APIs; packs are downloaded once on the machine that uses them (<home>/premade/packs/<id>) and searched by file name. Add a pack here with its maker's licence and a stable download address.

sources.name: Poly Haven
sources.note: photoreal props, PBR materials and skies; the API asks for a 'Powered by Poly Haven' mention in tools built on it

sources.name: Sketchfab (downloadable, CC0 / CC-BY)
sources.note: search needs no key; fetching needs a free account's token. Quaternius's Ultimate Monsters and many rigged characters are here

sources.name: Poly Pizza
sources.note: 10,000+ low-poly models incl. Quaternius and 100 Avatars; a free key

sources.name: Godot Asset Library
sources.licence: permissive per plugin (MIT, Apache, BSD, MPL, CC0) - GPL left out
sources.note: editor plugins and add-ons: dialogue, terrain, cameras, controllers, shaders

sources.name: sand3d (Sandflow)
sources.note: objects as short programs over Blender: arguments are sliders, joints move; built on the machine with Python 3.11/3.13
